### Accessibility and behavior

- Each role is visible text inside one inline noninteractive group
- An empty list falls back to a visible label

Role: `none`.

Accessible name: `none` strategy targeting `:root`.

| Keyboard input | Declared outcome |

| None declared | No component-owned keyboard behavior is declared. |

### Compatibility

Mirrors renderRoleBadgeList: roles, then badges, roleLabels or value (records read label/name/role/value/id, scalars render as text) render one data-role-badge item each inside a span carrying data-badge-variant from variant, then tone, then roles; with no items the label, then text, then Roles is the visible fallback; authored children replace the list. rolesField lowers to roles and fallbackRoleParameter is consumed.
